database_summary: Cricket match dataset with entities for players, teams and matches plus ball-level and event-level tables (ball_by_ball, batsman_scored, wicket_taken, extra_runs) and a player_match bridge linking players to matches and teams. The schema captures match metadata (match), participants in a match (player_match), detailed ball-level events (ball_by_ball), runs by batsmen per ball (batsman_scored), wicket events (wicket_taken) and extras per ball (extra_runs). Small reference tables: player and team describe actors. Most tables are event/measurement-level except player, team and match which are descriptive/current-state rows.

accepted.name: ball_event_with_players
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.over_id,
  b.ball_id,
  b.team_batting,
  b.team_bowling,
  b.striker_batting_position,
  b.striker,
  striker_player.player_name AS striker_player_name,
  b.non_striker,
  non_striker_player.player_name AS non_striker_player_name,
  b.bowler,
  bowler_player.player_name AS bowler_player_name,
  m.match_date,
  m.season_id,
  m.venue,
  m.team_1,
  m.team_2,
  m.toss_winner,
  m.toss_decision,
  m.match_winner
FROM ball_by_ball b
LEFT JOIN player striker_player ON b.striker = striker_player.player_id
LEFT JOIN player non_striker_player ON b.non_striker = non_striker_player.player_id
LEFT JOIN player bowler_player ON b.bowler = bowler_player.player_id
LEFT JOIN match m ON b.match_id = m.match_id
accepted.description: Denormalized ball-level events joined with participating player and match metadata. Use this when answering questions that need per-ball context including which players (striker, non_striker, bowler), teams, and match-level attributes. | Use for: List ball-by-ball events with player names for a match/season/venue; Aggregate runs/wickets by bowler or batsman using ball-level joins; Filter balls by team batting or bowling and compute counts

accepted.name: batsman_runs_per_ball
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.over_id,
  b.ball_id,
  b.striker,
  p.player_name AS striker_player_name,
  bs.runs_scored
FROM batsman_scored bs
JOIN ball_by_ball b ON bs.match_id = b.match_id
  AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no
  AND bs.over_id = b.over_id
  AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id
LEFT JOIN player p ON b.striker = p.player_id
accepted.description: Ball-level pairing of batsman runs with ball event (to know which batsman scored on which ball). Useful for aggregations of batsman runs, strike-rate, and per-innings scoring. | Use for: Total runs by a batsman in a match/season/career; Balls where a batsman scored X runs; Strike-rate and scoring breakdown per batsman

accepted.name: wickets_with_kind_and_player
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  w.match_id,
  w.innings_no,
  w.over_id,
  w.ball_id,
  w.player_out,
  p.player_name AS player_out_name,
  w.kind_out
FROM wicket_taken w
LEFT JOIN player p ON w.player_out = p.player_id
accepted.description: One row per wicket event including dismissed player name and basic match context. Use for per-player dismissal counts, types of dismissals, and timeline of wickets in an innings. | Use for: Count dismissals by player or by kind; Sequence of wickets in an innings or match; Which players were out and how in a match

accepted.name: extras_per_ball_with_type
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  e.match_id,
  e.innings_no,
  e.over_id,
  e.ball_id,
  e.extra_type,
  e.extra_runs
FROM extra_runs e
accepted.description: One row per ball extra runs event joined with ball identity and match/innings. Use to analyze extras by type, totals conceded by innings, or to attach extras to balls for total-run calculations. | Use for: Aggregate extras by type per match/innings/season; Compute total extras conceded by a team in an innings

accepted.name: player_match_roster
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.match_id,
  pm.player_id,
  p.player_name,
  pm.role,
  pm.team_id
FROM player_match pm
LEFT JOIN player p ON pm.player_id = p.player_id
accepted.description: Normalized roster of players in each match with their role and team. Useful to filter players by role (Captain, Keeper) or to join match-level stats back to the player roster. | Use for: Who played in a given match and what was their role; List captains or keepers across matches; Join player-level aggregates back to the roster for match-level reporting

accepted.name: match_summary_basic
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  match_id,
  team_1,
  team_2,
  match_date,
  season_id,
  venue,
  toss_winner,
  toss_decision,
  win_type,
  win_margin,
  outcome_type,
  match_winner,
  man_of_the_match
FROM match
accepted.description: Canonical match-level projection exposing common descriptive fields. Use when reporting match metadata or joining to season/team aggregates. | Use for: Match listings by season/date/venue; Join match metadata to event-level stats

accepted.name: batsman_runs_agg_per_player_match
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.striker AS player_id,
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS runs_scored_in_match_innings
FROM batsman_scored bs
JOIN ball_by_ball b ON bs.match_id = b.match_id
  AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no
  AND bs.over_id = b.over_id
  AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id
GROUP BY
  b.striker,
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no
accepted.description: Aggregated runs scored by each batsman within each match and innings. Useful for match scorecards, per-match batting totals, and computing season aggregates when further grouped. | Use for: Per-match batting totals for players; Compute season or career totals by summing these rows; Identify top scorers in a match or innings (use with RANK cte)

accepted.name: wickets_agg_per_player_match
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  w.player_out AS player_id,
  w.match_id,
  w.innings_no,
  COUNT(*) AS wickets_in_match_innings
FROM wicket_taken w
GROUP BY
  w.player_out,
  w.match_id,
  w.innings_no
accepted.description: Count of dismissals (wickets) per dismissed player by match and innings. Use for per-match dismissal counts and to build player wicket aggregates. | Use for: Who was dismissed how many times in a match or innings; Aggregate to season/career dismissal counts

accepted.name: player_total_runs_season_window
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  r.player_id,
  m.match_date,
  m.season_id,
  SUM(r.runs_scored_in_match_innings) OVER (PARTITION BY r.player_id ORDER BY m.match_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_runs_by_date
FROM (
  SELECT
    b.striker AS player_id,
    b.match_id,
    b.innings_no,
    SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS runs_scored_in_match_innings
  FROM batsman_scored bs
  JOIN ball_by_ball b ON bs.match_id = b.match_id
    AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no
    AND bs.over_id = b.over_id
    AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id
  GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id, b.innings_no
) r
JOIN match m ON r.match_id = m.match_id
accepted.description: Running total of runs per player ordered by match_date (useful for career or season running totals). Exposes a running_total column that downstream filters can constrain by date ranges or season. | Use for: Show cumulative runs for a player over time; Compute running season totals for leaderboard progression

accepted.name: player_match_rank_top_scoring
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  r.match_id,
  r.innings_no,
  r.player_id,
  r.runs_scored_in_match_innings,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.match_id, r.innings_no ORDER BY r.runs_scored_in_match_innings DESC) AS runs_rank_in_match_innings
FROM (
  SELECT
    b.striker AS player_id,
    b.match_id,
    b.innings_no,
    SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS runs_scored_in_match_innings
  FROM batsman_scored bs
  JOIN ball_by_ball b ON bs.match_id = b.match_id
    AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no
    AND bs.over_id = b.over_id
    AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id
  GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id, b.innings_no
) r
accepted.description: Rank players by runs within each match (descending) exposing rank so downstream queries can select top N scorers per match by filtering rank <= K. | Use for: Top scorers in each match or innings; Select top-N batsmen per match for summaries
